recommendation: V114 is the general learned baseline: higher photo mean and lower tested color bias than Small; V115 remains useful for its higher known-camera mean and8-pixel high-noise carrier gain. Both improve over V112. Real foliage/neon/weak4-pixel detail and camera mottling remain unresolved.
scope: Complete original matched20k trained endpoints, eight evaluation stages, NumPy64 independent numerical audit, native photo/camera/GFX viewing and four verified TIFFs. Tiny/Small differ in frozen backbone and fitted Small lateral initialization. Source/scene intervals are not training-repeat uncertainty. Existing controls and all original receipts/sources remain unchanged. V116 is a separate newly running data trial.
